content: Ananiasbëd aton chido Sapida muaid
Adnubien dada utsi Ananias cuëmëdquid aton chido Sapidabëdtan aton nidaid menequin piucquid bedpanëdash.
Bedshun aton chidon isnubi musucbanshun ambi musucaid utsi dayun uash Esus chuibenequido yacno nidshun abitedi meniacbimboen menepanëdash Ananiasën.

Adnubien, Piucquid abitedi meniacbimboen Ananiasën mua uaposh, quequin Nuquin Papan Mayanën tantiamiac naden Petedon Ananias chuipanëdash: —Satanasën tantiamiaid icquin ¿mitsipaden tantiaquin Nuquin Papan Mayanën isnubi mua uaquin ëbi menio?

¿Min nidaid meniabi icnuc mitsanapenquioda nediosh? Mitsana niosh. Adecbidi, ¿aidi menequin piucquid bedaid mitsanapenquioda nediosh? Aidtedi mitsana niosh. ¿Mitsipaden tantiaquin piucquid abitedi meniacbimboen meniano? Aden bëquin abimbo chienquiocquin Nuquin Papambobi mimbi mua uaboc
—Petedo quesho tantianec Ananias unësequi uebudpanëdash. Adsho isash Esus tantiaquidtedi dacuëdpanëdash.
Unësacsho isun dashcute cuëshën dataneshun buanshun caniabon chococatampanëdash.
Bënë chococambic ushë abuctoan unësboedën chido aton bënë unësaid tantienquio yec choapanëdash.
Choasho isumbien: —¿Ada min nidaid menequin nëidtedi piucquid bedo? —Petedo quesho tantiashien: —Ai, aidtedi bedombi —quepanëdash Sapida.

Adoaquien Petedo: —¿Nuquin Papan Mayanën ëbi muasho tantiapec, quequin tantienquiocquinda min bënëbëdtambi min piucquid abitedi meniacbimboen meniano? Nëbi min bënë chococaboedon mibitsen buanendac —Petedo quenubic
Petedon tayumbi uebudec Sapida unëspanëdash. Aidtsen unësacsho buanshun aton bënëbëdtabi chococatampanëdash.
Adoac aid daëdi unësaid tantiash Esus tantiesatedi Esus tantiaquidobëd comapenec dacuëdcuededpanëdash.
Bë-bëaidtedi bëdanaid
Adashic Sadomonën tacpan caid yacnoësh Esus tantiaquido iccuedednubi Esus chuibenequidon nadatiambocquin nabampanëdash.
Adomboen nabansho isash Esus tantiesabo dacuëdec tacpan yacno chotiapimbo yequi: —Esus tantiaquido bëdamboshë iquec —quecuededpanëdash.
Adec tabadequi utsi-utsiec dadpen dadabëdi chido Esus tantiaquido yampanëdash.
Adec Esus tantiaquid yanshun, Daicsaido Petedon bëdamepec, quequin tantiaquin daicsaido bë-bëshun Petedo capuacno nambededpanëdash.
Adembidi dëuequidon Edusaden yacno daicsaid bë-bënubi mayan icsan mëyanaido bë-bëoapanëdash. Aden bë-bëaidtedi bëdampanëdash.
Esus chuibenequido tsusiobon quënën nauedmiaid
Adnubien isadaidbo ancaquidbëd tsusio dapa utsibo saduseyobo caid isec otacquio tabadboedi matses dadpen Esus chuibenequido yacno cho-chosho isash nëishcuededpanëdash.
Adec nëishcuededshun Esus chuibenequido bedmeshun quënën nauedmepanëdash.
Aid inchëshëmbi Nuquin Papan uaid mayan bëda choshon quënë shëcuë bëtashaid bëcadoquin abitedi puduemec:
—Mibi puduemiombique. Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid yacno nidtan. Ambo puduedshun Esus tantiaquid uincuentequid chuibanoata —quepanëdash Nuquin Papan uaid mayan bëda.

Badiadnuc Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaidën puduedshun Esus tantiaquid abi uincuentequid chuibanoaic tabadoapanëdash aidtedi. Chuibanubien isadaidbo tsusio dapan abëd icquidobëdtambi tsusio utsibotedi cho-chomeshun: —Esus chuibanquido bedtan —cac
quënën nauedaid puduenushe quequin isquido chuiquid nidshun isquien Esus chuibenequido nibëdec.

Adsho isash choaquin: —Quënë shëcuë bëdamboen bëtashquin quënën nauedaid puduenushe quequin isquido shëcuë cuëmano capusho isombi. Shëcuë bëcadoash puduedshun isaquien ënden puduen-puduenac —quepanëdash quënën nauedaid puduenushe quequin isquido chuiquid.
Aden chuisho tantiash isadaidbo tsusiobo: —¿Atodain nechitec? —quepanëdash Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid isquido chuiquid chiec.
Adnubien dada utsi choshon: —Mimbi quënën nauedboedon Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid yacnoshon chuibanoasho tantiombi. ¿Ada tantio? —capanëdash.

Adoaquien quënën nauedaid puduenushe quequin isquido chuiquid capitan caidën ambi namiaidobëdtan tantiec nidshun bedtanquin bëoapanëdash. Matsesën cuënoten ëbi se-senushe queshun mëyanenquiocquin Esus chuibenequido bëoapanëdash.
Aden bëquin Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid nuntan tsusiobo iccuededacno yuedpanëdash. Bësho isash tsusio dapambo:

—Esus chuibenenda, quequin chiambocquidëmbimboen Esus chuibanquin Edusaden yacnocquidtedi mimbi tantiamebanoc. Adoquimbic, Esus unës uaid tsusiobon naid nec, quequin mimbi chuibanoc —quepanëdash tsusiobo.
Adsho Esus chuibenequido utsibon tantianubi Petedonuidi: —¿Matsesën nata caidodabi nedi? Nuquin Papan nata caid icquin nabanembi.
Mimbi cuesten dectanquin unës uaondaid Esuquidistu Nuquin Papan padpiden uincuemepanëdash. Nuquin Papa caid tsusedpabon Papa caidquio nec.

Esus uincuemeshun aton dayunquio tsadmequin matses bëyucanquin Chuiquid abi yacno matses Puduedmequidquio icmepac. Aden nabanaid isadaidbo aidi abimbo tantiaquid icpashun ma abi icsaid Nuquin Papa bëpiscudpanuna.
Esuquidistun nabansho isbempondambi. Adembidi abi unësash uincuenacsho ispondambi. Nuquin Papan Mayan icsaisan Esuquidistu tantiaquidobëd icquidëmbi adomboen ëbitedi tantiameoaic —quepanëdash Petedo.
Aden Petedon chuisho tantiash tsusiobo: —Icsambo iquec —quiash Esus chuibenequido cuesunete bumpanëdash.
Adnubien isadaidbo utsi padiseyobo, Nuquin Papan Moises dada uamiampid chuibanquin tantiamequid utsibon bëdamboen isaid, Camadied cuëmëdquidën: —Chiata. Bëboedtedi buantan —cac
buanambic: —Icsamboen nanushe queshun bëdamboen tantiaquiota. Aido cuesunete mibi buneque. Cuesunenushe chiata.

Ëndenquio utsi Teyudas cuëmëdquid icpondash. Aidi tsusio dapa icnuequin chuisho tantiash dada dadpen 400ted abëdi capupanëdash. Teyudas cuesuniacsho isash abëd icboedtedi udi nidaniacsho padpiden isenquio icpanëdash.

Adashien matses tambanta caid ushëmbi utsi Udas cuëmëdquid Cadidia yacno icnëdaidbëd matses dadpen capupanëdash. Udastsen cuesuniac abëd icnëdaidtedi padpidec choenquio yec adecbidi udimbo nidanepanëdash.
Adec umanuc buamboedo chuiquid nibëdanaque. Aidbëd icboedo mishenda. Cuesunemenda. Aidën chuibanaidbëdtabi ambi naid matsesën naiduidtsëqui icnuc badedquio ënëdendac.
Aido Nuquin Papan namiac chuisho mimbi ëmetiapimbo iquendac. Nuquin Papa chieshënushe queshun aido nidmeta.
Aden Camadiedën chiac: —Adonona —queshun: —Buamboedo bëoata —cac bëacsho cueshcanten cuesmepanëdash. Aden cuestanquin: —Esus chuibanoainquio yec nidtan —queshun puduemepanëdash.
Puduemiac Esus mëyanaid tantiec nidequi abi chuibansho mëyanaid yec bëdambo iquebi, quec tabadpanëdash.

Adshumbic badiadquidën-badiadquidënquien Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid yacnoshon matses bëyucanquin chuiquid, Nuquin Papan bëdamboen isaidquio Esus nec, quequin chuibampanëdash aidon. Shubu utsi-utsiec yacno nidshun adomboembidi chuibenepanëdash.
